meta.title: AI Hiring for Experienced Professionals | letshyre.ai
meta.description: Hire experienced professionals on evidence. LetsHyre ranks candidates with AI resume analysis, role-based interviews and scorecards you can check.

hero.title: See how they interview
hero.description: Every LetsHyre candidate has taken a role-based AI interview. You get a ranked shortlist with scores, a scorecard and the recording, and pay only for the people you want to meet.

unlock.body: Compare every candidate for free. When someone looks right, one credit unlocks their resume, contact details, documents and recording. Then reach out however you like.

professionals.body: Take a role-based AI interview from the LetsHyre desktop app, whenever it suits you. Your scorecard joins the talent pool for 90 days, where employers hiring for your role find you.

A skill scorecard after every interview
Free for professionals, start to finish
